grammar.title: 语法知识 情态动词can，must，may
lines: 3 动词分类 情态动词 概念：表示情感、态度，包括：can(could), must, may(might), will (would) ... 用法：+ 动词，且原形 没有 人称和数的变化 一般疑问句： 情态动词提前 情态动词的否定句：
连系动词 (Linking verbs)：表示状态、性质或身份的动词，用来连接主语和表语。
情态动词 (Modal verbs)：表示情感、态度、能力或推测等含义的动词。
实义动词 (Main verbs)：表示具体行为或状态的动词，承载动作的核心含义。
助动词 (Auxiliary verbs)：与其他动词搭配使用，用来构成时态、语态、否定和疑问等结构。
You must go out! 你必须出去！
Can you please stand up? 请你站起来好吗？
He can do/read it. 他能做/读它。
人称 Be动词 情态动词
She She is ... She can ...
He He is ... He can ...
It It is ... It can ...
I I am ... I can ...
They They are ... They can ..
陈述句 一般疑问句 回答
He can read it. Can he read it? Yes, he can .
He can do it. Can he do it? Yes, he can .
can → can't (不可用 can not )
can → cannot 要连在一起不能分开
must → mustn't (表:禁止，绝对不允许) 使用don't need to 替代
may → may not （要分开）
原句 变为一般疑问句 变为否定句
Tom can swim well. Can Tom swim well? Tom can't / cannot swim well.
The students must finish their homework tonight. Must the students finish their homework tonight? The students don't need to finish their homework tonight.
I can stay with you. Can I stay with you? I can't / cannot stay with you.
She can drive to school. Can she drive to school? She can't / cannot drive to school.

sentences.title: 单词句型 情态动词练习
lines: 3 cake 可数 名词 biscuit 可数 名词
单词 词性 中文含义 音标 例句
lift v. 举起 /lɪft/ Can you lift this heavy case?
n. 电梯 There are thirteen people in this lift , it’s overweight.
cake n. 蛋糕 /keɪk/ I bought a chocolate cake for the party.
biscuit n. 饼干 /'bɪskɪt/ Would you like a biscuit with your tea?
She baked three cake s for the party. 她 为 派对烤了三个蛋糕。
He bought some biscuit s from the bakery. 他 从 面包店买了一些饼干。
They are typing these letters. 他们正在打这些信
They can type these letters. 他们能够打这些信。
She is making the bed. 她正在整理床铺。
She can make the bed. 她会整理床铺。
You are swimming across the river. 你正在游过河流。
You can swim across the river. 你能够游过河流。
We are coming now.
We can come now.
We are running across the park.
We can cross / run across the park.
He is sitting on the grass.
He can sit on the grass.
I am giving him some chocolate.
I can give him some chocolate.

Help: 实义动词，表示帮助。这里表示无能为力。

You: 主语，代词。
Give: 实义动词，表示给予。
Me: 宾语，代词。
